headlines: 尖沙咀私家車衝上行人路致一死三傷 (Car plows onto sidewalk in Tsim Sha Tsui, killing one and injuring three others)
選委會界別分組補選投票結束投票率達98% (Results roll in as polls close for Election Committee subsector ordinary elections)
葉劉淑儀指中美俄領袖深圳會晤彰顯國家關鍵地位 (Regina Ip highlights nation's pivotal standing following historic trilateral meeting in Shenzhen)
商務部堅決反對美FCC擬禁止中資電信營運商獲取美國電話號碼 (Ministry of Commerce opposes US FCC vote targeting Chinese telecom operators)
美墨聯合行動擊斃七人並拘捕十大通緝犯毒梟 (FBI and Mexican forces capture top 10 most wanted cartel boss after deadly shootout)
聯合國土耳其氣候大會加時談判以打破協議草案僵局 (UN Climate Conference in Turkey adds extra day of talks amid fossil fuel row)
港智簽署工作假期計劃並擬擴大青年內地實習 (Hong Kong signs working holiday scheme with Chile and expands youth employment)
神舟二十四號即將升空並將搭載首位巴基斯坦太空人 (Shenzhou 24 mission set to make history by carrying first Pakistani astronaut)

items.zh: 猛烈撞上；衝向（行人路或建築）
items.en_ex: A private car lost control and plowed onto the crowded sidewalk, injuring several pedestrians.
items.zh_ex: 一輛私家車失控衝上擁擠的行人路，導致數名行人受傷。

items.en_ex: The driver swerved suddenly to avoid hitting a stray animal on the road.
items.zh_ex: 司機突然急轉彎，以避開路上的一隻流浪動物。

items.en_ex: The motorist was arrested after attempting to flee the scene following a fatal collision.
items.zh_ex: 該名司機在致命碰撞事故後企圖逃離現場，隨後被捕。

items.en_ex: Police detained the driver after he failed a roadside breathalyzer test.
items.zh_ex: 司機未能通過路邊呼氣酒測後，被警方拘捕。

items.en_ex: Terrified pedestrians dashed inside a nearby shop to evade the oncoming speeding vehicle.
items.zh_ex: 受驚的行人紛紛衝進附近的一家店舖，以躲避迎面飛馳而來的車輛。

items.en_ex: Broken glass and vehicle debris were strewn across the street after the violent collision.
items.zh_ex: 劇烈碰撞過後，破碎的玻璃和車輛殘骸散落滿街。

items.en_ex: Witnesses described the fleeing suspect as a youthful person of remarkably short stature.
items.zh_ex: 目擊者形容逃逸的疑犯是一名身材相當矮小的年輕人。

items.en_ex: The government overhauled the electoral framework to enhance administrative efficiency and social stability.
items.zh_ex: 政府全面改革了選舉框架，以提升行政效率與社會穩定。

items.en_ex: The final voter turnout exceeded expectations, reaching an impressive ninety-eight percent.
items.zh_ex: 最終投票率超出預期，達到了令人矚目的百分之九十八。

items.en_ex: Citizens urged elected representatives to prioritize pressing livelihood issues like affordable housing.
items.zh_ex: 市民敦促當選代表優先處理如經濟適用房等緊迫的民生問題。

items.en_ex: Supporters held brightly colored placards outside polling stations to attract prospective voters.
items.zh_ex: 支持者在投票站外高舉色彩鮮豔的標語牌，以吸引潛在選民。

items.en_ex: Registered electors queued patiently to cast their ballots before polling stations closed.
items.zh_ex: 登記選民在投票站關閉前耐心地排隊投下自己的一票。

items.en_ex: The active campaign embodies the vibrant spirit of broad civic participation.
items.zh_ex: 熱烈的競選活動體現了廣泛公民參與的蓬勃精神。

items.en_ex: Hundreds of ambitious candidates are vying for limited seats in the legislative assembly.
items.zh_ex: 數百名雄心勃勃的候選人正在爭奪立法議會中有限的席位。

items.en_ex: Officials expressed confidence that the vote counting would conclude within a reasonable time frame.
items.zh_ex: 官員們表示有信心計票工作將在合理的時間範圍內結束。

items.zh: 在……間隙；在……場邊（非正式場合）
items.en_ex: World leaders convened on the sidelines of the international economic summit to negotiate peace.
items.zh_ex: 各國領袖在國際經濟峰會期間舉行場邊會晤以商討和平。

items.en_ex: The bilateral agreement plays a pivotal role in maintaining stability across the Pacific region.
items.zh_ex: 該雙邊協議在維護整個太平洋地區的穩定方面發揮著關鍵作用。

items.en_ex: Senior diplomats must be well versed in global geopolitics to navigate delicate negotiations.
items.zh_ex: 資深外交官必須精通全球地緣政治，以駕馭微妙的外交談判。

items.zh: 驚天動地的；具有重大影響的
items.en_ex: The summit produced an earth-shattering declaration that fundamentally altered global diplomacy.
items.zh_ex: 峰會發表了一份具備重大影響的宣言，從根本上改變了全球外交格局。

items.en_ex: Both nations agreed in principle to reduce their greenhouse emissions over the next decade.
items.zh_ex: 兩國原則上同意在未來十年內減少溫室氣體排放。

items.en_ex: The city must leverage its strengths in international finance to remain competitive globally.
items.zh_ex: 該城市必須發揮其在國際金融方面的優勢，以保持全球競爭力。

items.en_ex: The administration aims to spearhead trade initiatives that foster long-term regional economic growth.
items.zh_ex: 當局旨在引領促進區域長期經濟增長的貿易倡議。

items.zh: 注定受益；很有可能獲利
items.en_ex: Local enterprises stand to benefit immensely from closer cross-border economic integration.
items.zh_ex: 本地企業注定將從更緊密的跨界經濟整合中大幅受益。

items.en_ex: Critics argued that political factions frequently exploit sensitive international disputes for domestic gain.
items.zh_ex: 批評人士指出，各政治派別經常利用敏感的國際爭端來謀求國內利益。

items.en_ex: Government spokespersons voiced strong opposition to the foreign trade sanctions imposed yesterday.
items.zh_ex: 政府發言人對昨日實施的對外貿易制裁表示強烈反對。

items.en_ex: The trade ministry officially condemned the market ban as an unjustified abuse of regulatory power.
items.zh_ex: 商務部正式譴責該市場禁令是毫無道理的濫用監管權力。

items.en_ex: Every sovereign state reserves the legal right to safeguard its core economic security.
items.zh_ex: 每個主權國家均保留維護其核心經濟安全之合法權利。

items.en_ex: The notorious drug kingpin was finally arrested following a coordinated multinational investigation.
items.zh_ex: 經過跨國聯合調查，臭名昭著的毒梟頭目終於落網。

items.en_ex: The fugitive operated across multiple borders using a false passport and an alias.
items.zh_ex: 該逃犯使用假護照和化名在多國邊境之間活動。

items.en_ex: Federal agents tracked the dangerous fugitive to an isolated ranch in the desert.
items.zh_ex: 聯邦執法人員追蹤這名危險的逃犯至沙漠中一座偏僻的農場。

items.en_ex: A ferocious firefight erupted between elite tactical officers and armed syndicate members.
items.zh_ex: 精銳特警與武裝犯罪集團成員之間爆發了激烈的槍戰。

items.en_ex: Violent street clashes between rival gangs continue to terrorize local suburban residents.
items.zh_ex: 敵對幫派之間的街頭暴力衝突繼續令當地的郊區居民心驚膽戰。

items.en_ex: Forensic experts recovered dozens of metallic bullet casings from the crime scene.
items.zh_ex: 法證專家從犯罪現場起獲了數十枚金屬子彈殼。

items.en_ex: Authorities promised to crack down on organized crime syndicates smuggling narcotics into the country.
items.zh_ex: 當局承諾將嚴厲打擊向該國走私毒品的有組織犯罪集團。

items.en_ex: The controversial policy proposal drew widespread condemnation from human rights and environmental organizations.
items.zh_ex: 這項具爭議的政策提議引發了人權與環保組織的廣泛譴責。

items.zh: 極有可能會；正走向（某結果）
items.en_ex: Without meaningful compromises, delegates are on course to deliver an ineffective climate agreement.
items.zh_ex: 如果沒有實質性妥協，各國代表極有可能會拿出一份毫無成效的氣候協議。

items.en_ex: The veteran ambassador was chosen to preside over the tense international negotiations.
items.zh_ex: 這位資深外交官獲選主持這場氣氛緊張的國際談判。

items.en_ex: Negotiators spent an additional day discussing minor procedural rules rather than core environmental targets.
items.zh_ex: 談判代表又花了一天時間討論次要的程序性規則，而非核心環境目標。

items.en_ex: The municipal administration agreed to subsidize wages for young graduates entering high-tech industries.
items.zh_ex: 市政府同意為進入高科技產業的年輕畢業生提供工資補貼。

items.en_ex: The government increased the annual quota for students participating in overseas exchange programs.
items.zh_ex: 政府增加了參加海外交流項目的學生年度配額。

items.zh: 職能對等的人或事物；同行
items.en_ex: The foreign minister conferred with his European counterparts regarding ongoing regional stability.
items.zh_ex: 外交部長與歐洲同行就當前的區域穩定問題進行了商討。

items.en_ex: Astronauts prepared the orbital module's sleeping quarters prior to welcoming the new crew.
items.zh_ex: 太空人在迎接新機組成員之前整理好了軌道艙的睡眠區。

items.en_ex: The space station was fully stocked with fresh water and essential daily necessities.
items.zh_ex: 太空站內儲備了充足的淡水和基本生活必需品。

items.en_ex: Engineers conducted exhaustive safety inspections before clearing the crewed spacecraft for launch.
items.zh_ex: 工程師在批准載人太空船發射前進行了詳盡的安全檢查。

items.en_ex: Local residents gathered at the cultural center to celebrate their compatriot's historic aerospace mission.
items.zh_ex: 當地居民聚集在文化中心，慶祝他們的同胞完成歷史性的航天任務。

items.en_ex: The rocket successfully delivered its scientific payload into low Earth orbit this morning.
items.zh_ex: 今晨，該火箭成功將其科學有效載荷送入近地軌道。

items.en_ex: Practicing Muslims diligently adhere to specific daily prayer times regardless of geographic location.
items.zh_ex: 虔誠的穆斯林無論身在何處，都嚴格遵從特定的每日祈禱時間。

items.en_ex: Passengers were instructed to assemble in the designated evacuation area immediately.
items.zh_ex: 乘客接獲指示立即前往指定的疏散區域集合。

items.en_ex: The space laboratory will orbit our planet roughly sixteen times every twenty-four hours.
items.zh_ex: 該太空實驗室每二十四小時將繞地球軌道運行大約十六圈。

items.en_ex: Scholars clarified how individuals could fulfill their religious obligations under unprecedented environmental constraints.
items.zh_ex: 學者們闡明了個人在史無前例的環境限制下應如何履行其宗教義務。
